content.text: The campaign is live and the three line items are running. I'll check on it after the first few hours, then keep watching through the weekend.

Nine hours in, all three line items are delivering and spending at about the pace I expected. The Valentine's post has the most "Album stream" events so far, but the counts are small, so I'll wait before moving any budget.

After about 36 hours, the three line items have spent about $50 of the $100 total. Cost per "Album stream" so far:

- **Valentine's post (2152180535915606433):** 18 streams, about $0.93 each. Best.
- **New album intro (2151999341983788086):** 13 streams, about $1.29 each.
- **Details and listen (2152361729851255405):** 12 streams, about $1.39 each.

These are small counts, so the gap is not conclusive. Still, the Valentine's post is the cheapest per stream, and the intro post is the only one whose cost is below the Monday post's. Its line item ends at end of Sunday NZ time, so it has about 12 hours left. I'll move the budget toward it. I'll pause the intro post and keep the "Details and listen" post running through Monday. I'm keeping the total committed budget at exactly $100.00.

The Valentine's push ran Saturday 13 to Monday 15 February (Auckland time) and has ended. It spent $96.89 of the $100.00 budget and produced 103 "Album stream" events, about $0.94 each.

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Album streams | Cost per stream |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valentine's (2152180535915606433) | $36.07 | 131,766 | 100 | 42 | $0.86 |
| New album intro (2151999341983788086) | $27.91 | 117,614 | 69 | 29 | $0.96 |
| Details and listen (2152361729851255405) | $32.91 | 115,319 | 68 | 32 | $1.03 |
| **Total** | **$96.89** | **364,699** | **237** | **103** | **$0.94** |

**What I did**
- One campaign on the Visa ending 4487, with three ad groups, one per approved post. All used the "Album stream" pixel as the conversion goal. Russia and Belarus were excluded on every ad group.
- After about 36 hours, the Valentine's post had the lowest cost per stream, so I paused the intro post for about a day and moved budget toward the Valentine's post. When the Valentine's ad group ended on Sunday, I turned the intro post back on for Monday.

**Things you should know**
- The 103 streams include 10 view-through conversions. The pixel reports these as "Album stream", so I counted them as you asked. If you only want clicks-to-stream, the number is 93.
- The numbers are small, so the cost-per-stream differences between posts are not strong evidence. The Valentine's post was cheapest, but the gap is only about $0.17.
- Budget: I made an arithmetic error on Monday. My ad group caps added up to $113.93 on paper, not $100. Actual spend stayed under $100 ($96.89), so nothing went over, but the caps were wrong.
- The ad groups are still marked ACTIVE in the account, but they are past their end times and are not serving. I did not pause them, because the campaign has ended.
- Targeting is worldwide except Russia and Belarus. I did not add any language or location targeting, so a large share of the streams probably came from outside New Zealand.
- All three approved posts are in English. I did not promote the other-language versions you mentioned, since you named only these three.

The campaign is ID `v76m9`. I did not write any new posts or cards.
